Eastenders Stars, Chris Parker & Mo George answer the viewers questions & The Harlem Globetrotters play a game of basketball in the studio.
Liz helped re-house for the National Cat Centre, the newest member of the Blue Peter team is the kitten, named Smudge, the UK DJ champions are in, and you are shown how to make your very own Poncho
They are shown how to play Indian sports, there is a Hula performance, and you are shown how to make a safe hibernation spot for hedgehogs

The Olypmic relay team, Jason Gardener, Darren Campbell, Marlon Devonish and Mark Lewis-Francis, have a chat, the history of the Y-Fronts are shown and Meg Cabot, the 'The Princess Diaries' author is questioned

Dumbo rats are in the studio, Liz went to visit a place inspired by Anna Sewell's famous book Black Beauty, meeting Bomber the smallest Horse at the home and Janus who used to be the Queen's favourite horse, we find out why our weather has been so extreme and Tracy Island is made again

The new kitten is finally named, they show you how to make a pom pom toy for cats (And this is a present for the new kitten), the Christmas Competition (A Christmas Ident) is revealed and the Dabbawallahs take on Simon for the day in their trip to India.
Ferrets are in the studio and you were told how to care for them and Simon was Challenged to swim the English Channel with Alison Streeter.

They go to the Northampton Central Museum and Art Gallery and look at some famous shoes, Matt goes into London to see how made-to-measure clothes and shoes are made and the Tracy Island is finished today.
The gang learn about Bee Keeping, they visit a gardening club and they make sticky apple fingers.

Smudge is tagged and was given his 2nd set of injections, Belly Dancers are in and Matt joined the rat catchers of Mumbai and Konnie visited the Karni Mata temple in Desnok where ten thousand black rats run free on their trip to India.
Mag Cabot answered questions, Rachel Stevens sang her new song ""More More More"" and they look at Gadgets
A parrot called Mr. Chips was in, 2 top Poets were in and Konnie met Goli (a Langur monkey) and Shiam is his handler on the trip to India.
Matt & Simon practices some yo-dolling with some gentlemen from Holland and CBBC's Barney & Newsround's Lizo donate some clothes for the Welcome Home Appeal.
CBBC's Andrew & Angellica come into the studio and donate some clothes for the Welcome Home Apeal. And Liz makes a pencil case Click here for instructions

Liz was joined by an animal manager from Woburn Safari Park and 3 Malaysian Giant Pond Turtles called Donatello, Rafael and Michaelangelo. Young band Outl4w rocked the studio with their rendition of a punk classic - 'Black Flowers for the Grave.' The band were formed in May 2004 and received huge acclaim when they came second in a radio station's School of Rock Radio competition.

Zoe interviews Michelle Paver, author of the book 'Wolf Brother', Matt makes some Cock-a-Leekie Pie Click here for Instructions. The Noise Next Door perform ""Calender Girl"" and Simon practises his bagpipes and he Celebrates his birthday.

Matt travels to Cambodia. He walks the streets of the ancient cities, North and South, He drives north and trys a food specialty of the region, Giant Spiders!, in a tarantula farm run by a local women and her young daughter, he joins in with the royal ballet to perform a monkey dance like all the boys in the ballet, while the girls dance different dances, he also goes to see old museum full of…

Matt travels to America to be taught wrestling for another of his sporting challenges, Konnie spins some plates on sticks with guest, Andrew, Zoe takes her first pancake challenge, Click here for instructions. Liz and Simon look inside some plague village homes and tell the story of the family that started it.

Liz makes a valentines card Click here for instructions. Zoe enters a Wild Water Racing competition, Richard and his dog, Disco, demonstrated heelwork to music. This is a very popular performance at dogs shows and, in particular, at Crufts. After a very short lesson, Matt put Meg through her paces and they hope to show off their new skills when they visit Crufts next month.
Konnie travels to Angola to meet some of the families that have been reunited thanks to the Welcome Home Appeal.

eps.d: The Results Show of the Interactive Quiz, The fashion freaks won, the gaming wizards second, the animal lovers third and the chocalicks forth.

Matt learns how to do stunts in Florida and later perfroms in the high-flying show Sinbad, and Blue Peter dog, Meg, goes for a training session with a Profesional Dog Trainer, who trained Kyte who plays Wellard the Dog in Eastenders

Konnie & Simon reveal the winners of the Paint a Plane Competition, Dr.Bunhead came in to show us how a plane uses propulsion to fly. But nothing is as simple as that with the Professor of Silly Science. Only Dr. Bunhead would use custard powder to demonstrate how a plane works!

Simon turns photographer Simon loves photography almost as much as he loves sport so when he had the chance to combine them, he snapped up the chance! All of these photographs of the rugby action were taken by Simon, and he also took the photos of Shelley during today's rehearsals. Beanie Smudge Make Everyone loves Smudge and now you can make your very own beanie Smudge!

Matt & Liz travel the town of York, and tell its history, Liz goes to the biggest chocolate factory in England, she is shown how Smarties Chocolate are made and tastes the quality of them, Matt goes to a castle and tells us about bow and arrows and he and Meg are made into models in the York Museum.

Rhinoceroses Liz told the story of Clara the Rhinoceros, if you'd like to read more about her adventures, visit your local library as there's a book out called 'Clara's Grand Tour' by Glynis Ridley. Book Club The next book to be featured in the Blue Peter Book Club is 'SilverFin' by Charlie Higson published by Puffin. Find out more about Charlie Higson.

Simon goes to his home town, to train with the Norwich soccer team, he co-hosts a breakfast radio show on BBC Radio Norwich with presenter, Wally Webb. And finally he finds out about his family history with his parents.

Sir Patrick Moore 75 years ago, the most recently discovered planet in our solar system was discovered by an American called Clyde Tombaugh. The planet was called 'Pluto', a name chosen by an 11 year old girl from Oxford! To tell us about Pluto's discovery, Patrick Moore appeared on the show.

Eurovision Katie Price, Tricolore, Andy Scott-Lee, Javine and Gina G are this year's hopefuls to represent the UK in the Eurovision Song Contest. Vote for your favourite by watching Making your Mind Up on Saturday 5th March at 5.45pm - 6.45pm on BBC ONE (the results will be shown later that evening at 8.20pm - 8.45pm).

Wrestling Freestyle wrestling is a modern sport based on five thousand years of tradition. Many of the biggest stars in pro-wrestling entertainment began their careers in this sport, which features strength, speed and lots of different throws and attacks. If you want to get started, the British Wrestling Association welcomes complete beginners.

Konnie visited Uganda in East Africa to see how children there are benefiting from Comic Relief projects that your donations are helping to fund. She met Diana and Nilumansi, both of whose parents have died; but with your help, their future is looking brighter.

Today's show was full of ice, the studio was covered in an ice floor: The Sleeping Beauty Show on Ice UK tour came and performed for the Show. Ice Hockey They were joined by the Slough Bombers ice hockey team today. They put Zöe and Simon through their paces and challenged them to a penalty shoot out.

Sight, Taste, Touch, Smell, Hearing. Junior magician Jonathan Shotton was in the studio performing illusions to trick the eye. Jonathan has won junior championships for his tricks and show. He'll be performing in this years Magic Circle Young Magician of the Year competition which takes place in April. What you think of as taste, is actually flavour.

McFly McFly came into the studio and performed their Comic Relief song. They also took the time to do a quick interview for the website. Dawn French Comedienne Dawn French joined us to talk about how the money raised for Comic Relief gets used and how much is expected to be raised in 2005.

Mary Poppins 'Mary Poppins' is currently playing at the Prince Edward Theatre in London. Giant Shopping Trolley You would probably expect actor Ewan McGregor to travel through space to be with us, or to ride in to the studio on a motorbike, but not on Blue Peter. On today's show, he was transported into the studio on a three and a half metre tall shopping trolley!

Konnie, Matt & Simon took a look into the future. Crufts This year's dog that was named 'Crufts Best in Show' visited the Blue Peter studio, before returning home to Pennsylvania in America. She is a six year old Norfolk Terrier called Coco who took a lap of honour in the Blue Peter studio with her handler Peter Green.

Paint a Plane We unveiled the winning design from the Paint a Plane competition. It was painted on to the side of a Boeing 757 and will be seen flying around the world. Cheerleading The Ascension Cheerleaders spurred our winners on with an impressive pom pom and tumbling display.

Doctor Who Special Christopher Eccleston and Billie Piper, the stars of the new series of Doctor Who, join Matt, Liz and Simon today to talk about the show and what going to happen. Also, Simon and Liz join a professional swimming technique team, plus in the studio Simon makes a Easter Chick out of dough.

James Bond Special All the presenters get dressed up and perform some of the classic Bond theme tunes: 'The Man with the Golden Gun', 'For Your Eyes Only', 'Diamonds Are Forever', 'View to a Kill' and 'Nobody Does it Better'. Liz and Simon go to ""Spy School"" to learn the tricks of the trade that real spies use.
The Blue Peter Championship Part 1 The Reds Liz Barker Chris Collins Barney Harwood Nick Baker Dani Harmer The Greens Matt Baker Zöe Salmom Gemma Hunt Mark Speight Chris Perry-Metcalf.
The Greens Won!!!

Monster Truck Simon and Zöe roared into the studio in 'Lil Devil', the European Monster Truck Racing Champion. 'Lil Devil' can accelerate from 0-60mph in five seconds and can soar through the air, clearing up to 12 cars. 'Ark Angel' by Anthony Horowitz featuring Blue Peter competition winner Jonathan Bennet's gadget for Alex Rider was featured on the show Dalek Have you been impressed by Dr Who?

Simon was keeping his distance when he was joined by a shoal of piranhas from the Weymouth Sealife centre and an expert. Piranhas are one of the most infamous Amazon inhabitants. They are known for being incredibly mean. They are capable of stripping and eating even large prey in a matter of seconds. We had two species in the studio; the Red Belly and the Silver Dollar piranha.

Dolls' Kitchen Konnie made a beautiful kitchen for dolls on the show using lots of cardboard and a great deal of imagination. Today's show featured part two of this make Thai New Year This is a week of celebration for Thai people as it's the Buddhist New Year so ""Sawadee Pi Mai krap/ka"" to you! The Thai people celebrate in a very unusual way - they throw water over each other.
Simon and Zoe travelled to Iceland, where Simon trained with wolves , while Zoe searched for elves!

Northumbria Police Dog technology The Northumbria Police force demonstrated the latest police dog technology with their playful pooch, Butch. The fidocam is a mini camera, which police dogs wear on their heads when they are searching buildings for police suspects.
After 8 years, Simon Says Goodbye to Blue Peter

Superheroes In the studio today, Konnie, Matt, Liz and Zöe got all togged up in their superhero costumes and uncovered a few of the tricks of the film trade that give ordinary actors their superpowers. To find out who you voted for as your favourite superheroes, check the superhero page.

eps.t: Last Live Show of the Series!
eps.d: Text me home tent The presenters tried out the next Text me home tent, which lights up when you text it. Matt and Zöe's jive Following on from last Friday's dance special, Matt and Zöe performed their jive again, due to popular demand. Watch the challenge and see how Matt and Zöe got on.
Relive so of Simon's best bits. Part 1
Relive some more of Simon's memories.

The team launch a competition which offers a money-can't-buy prize to design a Sonic Device which will appear in the brand new series of Doctor Who! Stephen Nicholas, props supremo on Doctor Who will be in studio to help launch the competition, bringing with him an array of devices and props that have been used on the set of Doctor Who over the years.

Barney, Lindsey and Radzi have an update on Blue Peter's Doctor Who competition, which gives viewers the chance to design a Sonic Device which will then appear in the brand new series of Doctor Who in 2014. The team will also be showing you how to make Dalek cupcakes to enjoy with your friends for BBC One's 50th anniversary special.
After weeks of hard training it’s the final part of Lindsey Russell’s Mountain Marathon challenge. Will she manage to complete the 35-mile race across glaciers and skiing down the Swiss Alps?

Celebrities including actors James McAvoy and Chris O'Dowd, DJ Edith Bowman and author Michael Morpurgo explain their love of books. Barney Harwood also gets an insight into this year's 500 Words story-writing competition. Plus, scientist Greg Foot reveals the secrets behind electricity.
Blue Peter continues the mission to find CBBC Intelligence Officers. Over 5000 viewers applied but only three get the chance to go inside MI5's Headquarters.
With Christmas just around the corner, Lindsey and Radzi go head to head in an ice-sculpting challenge. The team take a look back at some moments from the past year.
Barney, Lindsey and Radzi host the first show of 2016. We go backstage at the Sports Personality of the Year awards and there's a look at the best bits of the show from 2015.
Barney heads to Blackpool and explores rays currently under threat in the wild. Lindsey goes down the deepest sewage tunnel in the UK.
The team are celebrating the Purple badge! The viewers are in control and the whole show will be dedicated with the things that they love and want to see on the show.
The team launch a huge new sporting competition. Sir Chris Hoy sets a speedy cycle challenge for Barney and Radzi in aid of Sport Relief.
Barney competes in the annual Great Olney Pancake Race and Barney and Radzi put pedal to the metal in the second part of their Sport Relief cycle challenge.
It is the grand finale of Barney and Radzi's cycle challenge at the National Cycling Centre. Also, Lindsey takes on a new character, Hysteria for CBBC's Dangermouse.
It's the first part of Lindsey's epic Sport Relief challenge, and the top three Best Story nominees for the Blue Peter Book Awards 2016 are announced.
Barney chats to Tim Peake. Angellica Bell reveals the Book Award winners and Mary Poppins gives a performance in the studio.

eps.t: A Batmobile, a Kung Fu Panda and a Wave Runner!
eps.d: Lindsey continues in her Sport Relief challenge. There's a behind the scenes look at the new Kung Fu Panda movie, a ride in the Batmobile and a performance from Lawson.

Live from the Velodrom in Queen Elizabeth Olympic Park, Blue Peter present a special edition for Sports Relief. In this episode, find out how Blue Peter's Lindsey Russell, 'The Wave Runner', does as she takes on one of the programme's most challenging tasks for Sports Relief. Elsewhere Barney shows where the money raised by Sports Relief goes.
A special following Lindsey Russell as she undergoes her Sport Relief challenge.

eps.t: The Walk That Changed the World
eps.d: In 1965 Martin Luther King led a march between the cities of Selma and Montgomery, Alabama USA. The marchers faced violence, intimidation and difficult conditions, but over the course of that 50 mile walk, thousands of people joined to raise awareness around the world and bring about huge changes to the rights of black people in the US.
Radzi goes behind the scenes on the set of CBBC's Wolfblood to see Blue Peter competition badge winner Myah in her starring role. US pop group JAGMAC perform live in the studio.
The team plant rocket seeds that have been to the International Space Station.
The team reveal the 2016 Team GB Blue Peter sport badge and Radzi joins the Royal Shakespeare Company to take part in a performance of A Midsummer Night's Dream.

eps.t: Get Your Team GB Sport Badge!
eps.d: Find out how to get the brand new Team GB sport badge, with some help from some famous sport stars. Plus Lindsey takes on a hockey challenge and Radzi attempts a roller derby.
Blue Peter guide dog Iggy meets her new owner, the team launch a brand new competition and Ashley and Pudsey perform in the studio.
The team say farewell to guide dog Iggy as she's off to assist her new owner, who is in the studio. Also, there's a special tribute song from Hacker T Dog.

This episode of Blue Peter is a fan club takeover, where viewers can control the show via the Blue Peter Fan Club. There are live online votes, viewer comments and a chance for you and your friends to become Fans of the Month! So if you've got your badge, the most important question is, are you part of the fan club yet?
Lindsey experiences what it is like to float like an astronaut and fly like a superhero in a zero-gravity plane. Also there is a recap of how our space rocket seeds are growing.
The team present a green badge special live from the Blue Peter garden, which has been given a makeover by a young gardening expert.
Lindsey and Radzi try their hand at indoor skydiving. Also, Tilly Ramsay gets ready for Father's Day with a special bake.

Radzi takes to the skies to join in a flypast over Buckingham Palace to celebrate the Queen's 90th Birthday. A football freestyler attempts a new world record. Also, Barney takes on the art of scratching with a world-famous DJ and is challenged to a solo performance with BBC Philharmonic orchestra.
The team gets up close and personal with some supersized creepy-crawlies and Radzi Chinyanganya chats to the stars of Secret Life of Pets. Plus, how to make a Shelley Pinata.
The Blue Peter team takes a look at some tricks of the film and TV trade.
The team meet the Paralympic team, who have won a staggering 143 medals. Lindsey gets to grips with the science behind the Wimbledon Tennis Championships.

The team celebrate the art of words through books, poems, letters and music! Lindsey reads out some of your Blue Peter letters at the prestigious Letters Live. Radzi visits the team behind Gangsta Granny and Barney shows you how to make an ingenious bookmark for your favourite book. Plus nine-year-old author Toby Little tells us all about his adventures in writing!

Blue Peter is live from Centenary Square in Birmingham, for the special CBBC Awesome Authors weekend! The team quiz a host of authors, including Holly Smale and David O'Doherty, with viewers' questions, and they create a story live on stage. Lindsey visits the Hay Book festival and we reveal the winner of the Dream Big competition.

Blue Peter has more from the special CBBC Awesome Authors weekend. We put Jacqueline Wilson to the test in a quiz against a team of superfans! Authors such as David Baddiel and Alex Smith join in with fun and games and Lindsey reads viewers' letters at Letters Live.

The Blue Peter team meet the Paralympic team who have won 143 medals. Lindsey gets to grips with the science behind the Wimbledon Tennis Championships. Also, the team are joined by a host of sporting heroes.

The Blue Peter team kick-start the summer badge baton relay, where they challenge viewers to earn all their Blue Peter badges, starting with the blue badge! To celebrate, Lindsey and Radzi get a head for heights by being strapped to a plane and attempt a wing walking challenge involving passing a baton to each other! Will they succeed?

The Blue Peter badge baton-relay continues with the sport badge 2016. Don't miss an exclusive look behind the scenes at the official kitting-out of Team GB. Also, Barney, Lindsey and Radzi try their hand at the Brazilian sport of footvolley.

eps.t: Go Green and Get Your Badge!
eps.d: It's a Green badge special, jam-packed with UK wildlife. We come face to face with the reptiles on our doorstep. Also, young gardening expert, George, is back to turn the Blue Peter garden into a bird haven.
The summer badge baton relay continues with the purple badge. Also Radzi chats to the cast of new film Swallows and Amazons, and Barney goes drone racing.
It's the last leg of the summer badge baton relay and the team end it in style by celebrating the silver badge! Also, Barney attempts a tin bath race-off the Isle of Man.

Blue Peter celebrates the end of the summer badge baton relay with a special live performance from chart topper Izzy Bizu and the cast of the Thundermans. Also Radzi and Barney head to the race track to take on top speeds with British GT champion Jamie Chadwick.

Barney, Lindsey and Radzi each attempt to break their very own record, involving planes, badges and straws! Lindsey puts the new five pound super-note to the test and Barney commemorates 350 years since the Great Fire of London.

Celebrate Roald Dahl's 100th anniversary with a fantabulous Blue Peter special. The team try to recreate the science from his famous books. Also, the cast of Charlie and the Chocolate Factory perform in the studio. Phizz-whizzing!

The team are joined in the studio by a host of Olympians to inspire viewers to earn their sport badge. We continue Lindsey's sailing journey off the Isle of Wight, Barney gets some tips from an up-and-coming young darts player and the cast of the new Disney show, The Lodge, show off their singing and dancing moves.
The team test their strength against the might of the England tug of war team. Radzi starts training for his epic water ski challenge. Plus pop band, The Tide, perform their latest single.

The fans take over on this episode of Blue Peter. Everything on the show has been requested by viewers. With live music, an update on favourite Blue Peter pets, and online superstar Dan TDM vlogging especially for Blue Peter.

In this live episode of Blue Peter, champion beatboxer Bellatrix puts the gang through their paces, Lindsey learns to talk like a deer and author and illustrator Liz Pichon hosts a live doodle-a-long.

This week on Blue Peter, we have the show-stopping F2 Freestylers being challenged by you with your football tricks! We reveal the winner of our Big Day Out competition, Barney hunts for magical creatures in a forest with Augmented Reality, Radzi catches up with stars from Trolls and M.O perform their new single.
This episode of Blue Peter is a Halloween spook-tacular! We show you how to make trick-or-treat cakes and reveal how to create your very own ghost. Also, the Blue Peter garden gets ready for winter.

eps.t: Jeff Kinney and the Wimpy Kid!
eps.d: Magician Jamie Raven wows with levitation. Superstar trials biker Danny MacAskill teaches Barney a few tricks, author Jeff Kinney talks about his new book and the team begin their epic Children in Need challenge!

Blue Peter is out of this world with special guest, Tim Peake! We catch up with the team's efforts in the second part of the Children in Need Try-Athlon Challenge. Also, the cast of musical The Wind in the Willows perform a television exclusive.

It's a Children in Need spectacular as Barney, Lindsey and Radzi run, row and cycle to the ultimate bake sale in their Extreme Try-athlon. Pop megastar Olly Murs performs his latest single. Plus someone will get goo-ed. Who? You decide!
Radzi goes behind the scenes of Fantastic Beasts and Where to Find Them, and the team are joined in the studio by some fantastic beasts of their own.
Children's magazine with information, topical items and performance.

Barney and Radzi compete at the European Curling Championships, Tom Fletcher tells some Festive Fibs and Nick James (AKA Hank Zipzer) gets messy answering viewers' questions. Plus, find out who has been nominated for Young Sports Personality of the Year 2016.

In this special Christmas edition, children from local schools will be singing a carol live in studio and the final light on Blue Peter's famous Advent crown will be lit. The cast of Chitty Chitty Bang Bang will perform a musical number, and Barney and Radzi will learn all about everyone's favourite festive vegetable… sprouts.
Barney, Lindsey and Radzi pick some of their favourite moments from a jam-packed 2016.
Lindsey and Radzi look back on some epic Blue Peter flying challenges.

Blue Peter celebrates its new blue badge design with an incredible live performance. Also, catch all the backstage action from Sports Personality of the Year 2016 and Gary Barlow's brand new talent show, Let it Shine!

eps.t: The Vamps and a Brand New Competition!
eps.d: Blue Peter turns purple as the team unveil the new look purple badge which is awarded for reviewing the show. Plus music from The Vamps. Jessica Ennis-Hill is in the studio to talk about a brand new competition.

The young stars of A Series of Unfortunate Events visit the studio to talk about the new series. The team celebrate the Lunar New Year with a fantastic rooster lantern that you can make at home and Barney showcases his photography and comedy skills.

The show is set alight with a magnificent fire performance and Europe's strongest man shows off his skills. The team head out to the Blue Peter garden, bird-spotting with young gardener George, plus Lindsey has a go at American football

Love is in the air on this week's Blue Peter, with instructions on how to make a card with a secret message for your Valentine and a romantic performance from Gabrielle Aplin. Plus a chat with Lego Batman himself and a caving adventure - with cheese!
David Walliams talks about his book Grandpa's Great Escape! Lindsey and Radzi test out their skills in a special game of golf and vlogger Nikki Lilly bakes some delicious treats for the team.

Sir Chris Hoy tells us all about Flying Fergus's antics in his latest book, Radzi gets creative just in time for Pancake Day, and Horrid Henry creator, Francesca Simon, goes head to head against some fans!

It's the Blue Peter Book Awards 2017. Who will be victorious in the Best Book with Facts and Best Story categories? To announce the winners Barney, Lindsey and Radzi are joined by young readers, rapper Doc Brown and... A giant puppet elephant.

Barney takes on the World Pasty Championships and enters a Blue Peter pasty. Singer and songwriter Gavin James performs his new single and gives us the lowdown on what it's like to tour with Ed Sheeran. Also, talent from the UK B-Boy Championships World Final 2017 showcase their awesome moves!
Barney attempts to come up with the world's funniest joke, there are some seriously impressive animals, and the show takes a look at viewers' LOLs.

It's Blue Peter's Red Nose Day spectacular! Barney takes on a special jokeathon challenge, and there are some laughs in the studio with all the jokes viewers have been sending in. Also, there's a special performance from Grease the musical.

eps.t: Tim Peake and a Space Make
eps.d: Get ready for blast-off with the very best of Blue Peter and space. Relive Tim Peake's epic journey to space, watch Lindsey float in zero gravity and try your hand at a brand new make that will let you keep the solar system in a jar.
It's the purple badge takeover, so everything has been requested by the viewers. Expect an internet superstar, amazing ballroom dancing and an actual ninja - with swords!

It's the Blue Peter make and bake special! Just in time for Easter, artist Jon Burgerman makes some fun egg splats, see how to make some edible emoji faces and emoji poos, and Barney enters a cake competition!

Radzi and Lindsey take on a zip-wire challenge, testing the scientific principles of friction. Lindsey gets involved with some lambing, and singer-songwriter JP Cooper performs his single September Song.

Find out who won the London 2017 Mascot Competition and see their design take shape. Also, Radzi has the time of his life as he heads behind the scenes at one of the world's biggest sporting events, Wrestlemania!

Callum and guide dog Iggy are back in the studio for a visit. Radzi and Lindsey go behind the scenes at the London Marathon, catch up with the second part of Radzi's trip to Wrestlemania, author Nick Mohammed tells us all about his magical-themed book and there will be a stunning performance from the winner of Young Magician of the Year 2017.
Blue Peter launches a brand new competition and it's all about... dragons! Kimberly Wyatt talks about her new books and Radzi tries to leap and roll his way to a new parkour world record.

Barney cleans some acoustic mushrooms at the Royal Albert Hall, Lindsey's back in the Blue Peter garden to spruce it up for spring! UK's Eurovision hopeful, Lucie Jones, performs her song, Never Give Up On You. Also, knights in shining armour showcase their jousting skills!

Lindsey faces her biggest fear - sharks! Plus the team head behind the scenes at the Eurovision Song Contest and count down to the deadline of the Blue Peter Design a Dragon competition. Only one week to go!

The winner of CBBC's Got What It Takes, Jorja, and CBBC's The Dengineers presenters Lauren and Joe visit the studio. Plus Lindsey and Radzi take on an ice hockey challenge, and Barney shows how to make colourful unicorn ice cream.
Learn how to make your own Shelley costume courtesy of a Blue Peter fan, find out how to take the perfect penalty and see Lindsey try on a beard of bees.

The team launch a spy-inspired competition with Anthony Horowitz himself! The outgoing Children's Laureate Chris Riddell joins us in the studio with the new 2017 Children's Laureate and Barney visits the European finals of the World Scooter Championships to see young scooter stars show off their tricks.

Blue Peter are celebrating BBC Music Day with some epic percussion from Stomp. Radzi takes on a sack race with a difference, and the team catch up with the youngest woman in the world to conquer both sides of Mount Everest!

Blue Peter has some furry Hollywood superstars in the studio and will be showing viewers how to make minion cupcakes. Also, it's just one week until the closing date of the Blue Peter Code-Breaker competition.

Medieval knights, their horses and lances show off some spectacular jousting. Barney takes on a downhill challenge on a mountain bike, and long-distance cyclist Mark Beaumont pops in to tell the team about his unbelievable challenge around the world!

The team are joined by some of the cast from CBBC's Hetty Feather for some Victorian-inspired fun and games! Radzi gets up close to some jellyfish, and Lindsey visits an amazing feat of engineering - a giant gadget known as the Falkirk Wheel.

Radzi learns to juggle with circus stars Bibi and Bichu, Barney tries on a dress to become the Queen of Hearts and Lindsey goes head to head with England women's international, Alex Scott, in a footy challenge.

Over 9,000 Blue Peter fans entered, and now viewers can find out who is the winner of the Design a Dragon competition. Also, watch London Stadium get transformed for a summer of athletics, and check out Radio 1's Greg James' and Chris Smith's super powers.

It's the start of this summer's big badge boat bonanza, with a Blue Peter make to help you store all your badges. Also, 5 After Midnight pop into the Blue Peter garden, and Lindsey and Radzi join the Royal Marines Commandos for a very messy challenge.

Blue Peter gets stuck in with all the World Para Athletics action in London. Join competition winner Elinor, as she heads behind the scenes at the Championships and find out how you can get your hands on the brand new 2017 sport badge.

t's a silver badge special, so the team invite some metal friends to the Blue Peter studio. Barney comes face to face with some seriously impressive and very cute robots. Also, everyone joins in to get the Blue Peter locomotive back up and running again.
It's a green badge special. Barney takes on a gigantic upcycling project. Lindsey surprises some green superstars, and young gardener George is back for an update on the Blue Peter garden.

This episode is all about the purple badge, which means viewers are in charge. So get ready for epic guitar skills, extreme cheese and lots of Blue Peter fans. Also, murder mystery author Robin Stevens will settle once and for all who took Radzi's wrestling outfit.
The 2017 sport badge season closes with a bang. Find out what everyone's been up to. Also, Barney takes on a mountain biking challenge and we catch up with the London 2017 competition winner.

On this week's record-breaking show, the team will attempt to smash world records involving hats, limbo dancing and peas! Barney has a go at learning a stunt car routine and Radzi works through the night to make sure your garden peas are as fresh as the day they are picked! All that and Freddie - a record-breaking dog!

eps.t: Code Breaker and Bye Bye Barney!
eps.d: On Barney's last ever Blue Peter, it's time to meet the winner of our amazing code breaker competition, as Barney joins them for an amazing spy day out in London.Barney also attempts a motorised dance routine in the second part of his stunt car challenge. Also, expect a few surprises for Barney along the way.
Lindsey gets to grips with the skills and speed of Irish dancing, and there are performances from the ballet version of Aladdin and 13-year-old singer, Beau Dermott. All that and your 3D post.

Get your pencils at the ready to take part in a live draw-a-long with author and illustrator Cressida Cowell. Also, we're joined by the stars of Descendants 2 and Lindsey attempts an Irish dancing routine in front of a massive theatre audience.

Ali-A joins us for a super-charged Blue Peter! There are performances from Dr Seuss' The Lorax and we witness some fast footwork from Tap Factory. Also, Radzi and Lindsey get put through their paces on the rugby field.

It's Blue Peter's birthday and we're celebrating with a special birthday quiz hosted by Harry Hill and our very own Shelley. Who has what it takes to be BP's ultimate fan? Also, Lindsey takes part in a rescue demonstration with the RNLI, and we unveil the Blue Peter Gold Badge Walk!

Dame Jacqueline Wilson takes the Blue Peter reins as guest editor of the show. We go behind the scenes at Matilda the musical, followed by an amazing performance from the cast in the studio. Also, we take a step back in time and revisit some sweet treats that would have been enjoyed during the Second World War.

Radzi begins training for his Children in Need Free-Fall challenge. Make a pumpkin treat bowl with Max and Harvey for Halloween. Also, find out how Blue Planet II is bringing the ocean to your TV screens like never before.

eps.t: Fan Club Takeover with Sophia Grace
eps.d: The Blue Peter fan club has taken over, with Sophia Grace performing live in the studio! There's also music from The Shades, plus we check out part two of Radzi's free-fall challenge.

Blue Peter's four-legged friend Iggy is back in the studio and is joined by CBBC's Pets Factor vets, Rory and Cheryl. Plus we check out part three of Radzi's epic Free Fall Challenge in aid of Children in Need.
It's the Blue Peter Children in Need Spectacular with Dan TDM, Pixie Lott and Pudsey Bear! Plus Radzi takes on the ultimate Children in Need challenge in Free Fall.

Blue Peter announces an amazing Worst Witch competition, Lindsey attempts to play blind cricket and author of the Jamie Johnson series, Dan Freedman pops into the studio. Plus, we announce the shortlisted books for the Blue Peter Book Awards.

Anne-Marie performs her latest single Heavy and the team show you how to make our 2017 Christmas card. We go behind the scenes at CBBC's The Dengineers, plus Lindsey joins a team in attempt to break the land speed record in a supersonic car!

Christmas is fast approaching, so warm your cockles with a performance from Nativity! The Musical. See if you've got what it takes to be the ultimate festive fan. Plus find out how many Radzis it takes to change a lightbulb 190 metres up in the air.

Blue Peter does Christmas with a 250 strong choir, a festive Boogie Storm performance and Tom Fletcher singing the jolliest song ever. Plus Lindsey helps choose the Christmas tree for 10 Downing Street and the winner of the Worst Witch competition is announced.
Blue Peter look back at an epic 2017. A whole year of Blue Peter awesomeness in a 28 minute chunk! Relive some of your favourite challenges, guests and makes.
Blue Peter look back at an epic 2017. Relive Radzi's entire epic skydiving challeng,e from training to attempting a parachute stack with the actual RAF Falcons!

It's an orange badge special. We announce the winner of the Awesome Animation competition while launching a brand new one for Blue Peter's big birthday in its 60th year. Also, Radzi and Sport badge holder Chloe head behind the scenes at BBC's Sports Personality of the Year 2017.
Lindsey joins Awesome Animation competition winner Rory on the red carpet, and Radzi gives indoor surfing a go. Get ready for plenty of wipeouts!

It's a purple badge take over as everything is suggested by Blue Peter purple badge holders! Young comedian Ned Woodman takes centre stage for some Blue Peter LOLs. We witness some impressive flute-beat boxing skills and Lindsey takes on a speedy challenge in a dragon boat.

eps.t: 5000th Show And A Brand New Badge!
eps.d: A special edition of Blue Peter marks the show's 5000th episode, with the launch of a new Diamond Badge, designed by international fashion designer Henry Holland. The first Blue Peter badge was launched 55 years ago, and today a host of well-known faces talk about how special the Blue Peter badge is.

Lindsey is joined by Strictly star Mollie King, who takes on Blue Peter presenting duties for the day! We commemorate Vote 100 and the suffrage movement, singing sensation Calum Scott performs his new single You Are the Reason, and there's a pancake challenge!

To celebrate the Winter Olympics, Blue Peter brings you a snow sport special! Radzi takes on a very special skeleton bob challenge, Lindsey gives snowboarding a go, and the two go head to head In a speed skating race! Where better to bring you a show full of action on ice, than the Swiss Alps?

It's an ice-cold special. Find out what it means to be chilly with epic liquid nitrogen experiments. Lindsey and Radzi try ice hockey, HRVY performs in studio, and our guest presenter is the coolest guy around, Steve Backshall!

It's the launch of the Blue Peter 2018 Sport Relief totaliser with the help of internet star Chris MD! Lindsey is joined in the studio by MOTD Kickabout's Ben Cajee, Radzi goes behind the scenes at the largest science experiment in the world and impressionist, Jess Robinson, sings a song or two.

It's the Blue Peter Book Awards, so we find out which books win Best Story and Best Book with Facts, as well as who is surprised with a gold badge. Plus we see if a simple book can support the weight of two presenters on a zip wire.

eps.t: Epic Rugby and a Cheesy Bake!
eps.d: Get set for Mother's Day with Lindsey and guest presenter Tyler West from MOTD Kickabout. We slice up the Blue Peter cheese to make the ultimate breakfast in bed. Plus Lindsey heads onto the Wembley pitch for a rugby league challenge and we announce March's Fan of the Month!

eps.t: Get Ready for a Mega Sport Relief!
eps.d: Get set for Sport Relief with Radzi and guest presenter Brad from The Vamps! How will they fare when trying flatland BMX riding with record holder Matti Hemmings? Also, we kick off Lindsey and Radzi's very own Mega Mileathon challenge!

Find out how Lindsey and Radzi got on with their Sport Relief Challenge. How many steps will they be able to add to the Mega Mileathon Totaliser? There's a sneak peek behind the scenes of Sport Relief. Plus Dako Flying Angels showcase their fantastic gymnastic display skills!

eps.t: Greg James and a Diamond Delivery
eps.d: Get set for Easter with Blue Peter. We'll show you how to reuse your Easter egg boxes to build a cool automaton. Radio 1's Greg James and Chris Smith pop in to talk superheroes and Lindsey delivers the very first diamond badges.

Warning, this is the most hair-raising and exciting episode of Blue Peter ever! Radzi conducts four million volts of electricity to shoot lightning bolts from his hands. Plus four motorbike riders race around the infamous Globe of Death, and we're joined by Henry Danger himself.

eps.t: The Big Birthday Balloon and Alesha
eps.d: We announce the winner and runners-up of our Big Birthday Balloon competition, with an extra special reveal of the winning balloon! Britain's Got Talent superstar Alesha Dixon tells us all about her new book and we also announce another competition.

This episode of Blue Peter has got it all. It's jam-packed. In fact there is so much in it, we'll struggle to tell you about it all right here. Especially when we spend so much time talking about how much is on the show. Oh, we've run out of space now. Watch it!

It's a packed animal special as meerkat pups, baby tortoises and piglets are in the studio! Vets from CBBC's The Pets Factor offer advice on your pets, Radzi joins a team of toad patrollers, and animal fan Naomi Wilkinson guest presents.

Blue Peter are teaming up with the world famous RAF Aerobatic Team, the Red Arrows, to offer a once-in-a-lifetime prize. Also, basketball legends the Harlem Globetrotters visit the studio to show off their epic skills and M.O perform their latest single, Bad Vibe.

We're having a Eurovision party, as UK entry SuRie performs her song Storm in the studio. We also catch up with Scott Mills and Rylan Clark-Neal in Lisbon for the latest Eurovision update. Also, there'll be more of you receiving your diamond badges and there's another chance to enter our Flying High competition, and be in with a chance of winning a once-in-a-lifetime prize.
You won't believe your eyes when we set fire to water using miniscule science. There's live music from Una Healy. Also, George is back to kick-start the Blue Peter garden.

We take a step back in time and uncover the contents of the Blue Peter time capsule, buried 20 years ago! We also want your ideas for a new BP time capsule and author Terry Deary will be giving you some inspiration. Also, Kidz Bop join us in the studio and perform hit song New Rules.

eps.t: Fan Club Takeover with Karina Garcia
eps.d: It's a Fan Club takeover so Blue Peter are taking requests. Prepare for world-record attempts from Officially Amazing and the queen of slime herself, Karina Garcia. Also, we check in with the Blue Peter time capsule on tour.

We're celebrating 30 years of the Blue Peter green badge! We hang out with some bees in the BP garden and also learning how harmful plastics can be to our environment. Also, we make a giant eco-friendly green badge and we go behind the scenes to see how Springwatch set up their nest cameras.

Blue Peter see Radzi become a tank commander to conquer some very muddy terrain. Marvel at a seriously talented circus act from Colombia. Also, find out how to make your very own blow football stadium just in time for the 2018 FIFA World Cup.

It's competition time on Blue Peter as we give you the chance to be a part of Blue Peter history by designing our diamond time capsule! Also, Lindsey visits the iconic Blackpool Tower for a spot of maintenance and Radzi shows you how you can recycle plastic bags to make your very own kite!

Blue Peter celebrate summer in the city with a party in the BP garden. They are joined by Now United for their UK TV debut. Magician Joel is ready to wow with some incredible sleight of hand tricks. Also, Radzi attempts to ride a penny farthing. What could possibly go wrong?

eps.t: Flying High Winners and Hetty Feather
eps.d: We announce the three winners of our Flying High competition. The star of Hetty Feather, Isabel Clifton, pops into the studio, Radzi tries not to fall into the water when he attempts paddle boarding, and there's another chance to enter our new Diamond Time Capsule competition and be a part of Blue Peter history!
We're launching the brand new 2018 Sport badge. It's all about giving a new sport a go, so we're trying footgolf, netball and freestyle skateboarding. Also, we're joined by a skateboarding dog!

Lindsey and Radzi celebrate the highly sought after orange badge with a special programme from the Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew. They are joined by the winners of not one but two incredible Blue Peter competitions to experience some once in a lifetime prizes.

Lindsey and Radzi are in Hull to catch up with the Blue Peter millennium time capsule as it continues its tour around the UK. Lindsey has a go at parking a passenger plane at one of the world's busiest airports and Radzi joins a unique electrical performance group.

eps.t: Kidz Bop and the Silver Badge
eps.d: It's a silver badge special. So we're celebrating all the fans who have done something different to earn theirs. Also, we witness the creation of a very special Blue Peter bee and Kidz Bop perform.

Lindsey and Radzi are at the European Championships Glasgow 2018 to celebrate the Blue Peter Sport badge with a show packed full of action. They try their hand at wheelchair basketball before going head to head with Team GB in a special exhibition match and Radzi has a go at indoor surfing.

Only two months to go until Blue Peter's 60th birthday! Past presenters, Katy Hill and Tim Vincent, join forces with two teams of BP super fans to take on the Diamond Badge Quiz. Also, Lindsey joins a lifeboat crew, Radzi delivers diamond badges and we announce August's fan of the month!
Blue Peter purple badge holders control the show. Everything has been requested on their purple badge forms, including stinky skunks, Irish dancing and a very funny comedian, Milton Jones.
Blue Peter is going green with a big beach clean, a recycled make, a special green badge giveaway and a visit to a pea farm. The green badge special couldn't get much greener.

eps.t: World Records Spectacular with Greg James
eps.d: Lindsey and Radzi attempt to break not one, not two, but three world records! All with a little help from Radio 1 Breakfast DJ Greg James. Also, Radzi takes to the track behind the scenes at the Formula One British Grand Prix.

eps.t: Creepy Crawlies and a Cool Competition
eps.d: Blue Peter's brand new competition is launching. Also, we celebrate Roald Dahl Day with creepy crawlies straight from the pages of James and the Giant Peach, blow your mind with an incredible contortion act from Cirque du Soleil and catch up with Callum and Iggy.

Magician and illusionist Jamie Raven marvels us with some amazing trickery. Lindsey attempts the art of bell ringing and Blue Peter Book Award-winning author Cressida Cowell tells us about her latest book release, The Wizards of Once: Twice Magic.

It's your last chance to earn the 2018 Sport badge. Some incredible sport personalities will be trying to earn theirs by attempting a new sport in the Blue Peter studio. Will they have what it takes to join Team Radzi? Also, Lindsey starts training for a truly epic challenge involving the big birthday balloon!

With not long to go until Blue Peter's diamond anniversary, we reveal an actual Blue Peter diamond... and then burn it! Also, Madagascar the Musical perform in studio and Lindsey continues her Chair in the Air challenge.

To celebrate Blue Peter's upcoming Big 60th Birthday show, illustrator Nick Sharratt draws some of Blue Peter viewers' favourite memories. Lindsey's Chair in the Air challenge hots up, and Paddington Bear is awarded a very special badge in honour of his 60th anniversary.

Sixty years on from Blue Peter's very first episode, past presenters return to celebrate with makes, games and lots of classic BP. Lindsey attempts to fly a hot-air balloon in the Arctic Circle, Radzi boards an aircraft carrier to create a massive birthday message, and we give Ed Sheeran a very special surprise. Also, there is music from Jonas Blue, HRVY, The Vamps and Sophie Ellis-Bextor.

We bring back Blue Peter's bring-and-buy sales and we show you how to put on the perfect one for Children in Need. Lindsey starts her latest physical endurance challenge - Swim Run, also some master UK speedcubers will be showing off their skills in the studio and putting the presenters to the test.

Lindsey continues training for her toughest challenge yet, and we get you set to run your own bring-and-buy sale for Children in Need. Also, Horrible Histories creator Terry Deary and illustrator Martin Brown are in studio to put their historic knowledge to the test.

Lindsey's Swim Run challenge is heating up and we show you an easy make to sell at your Children in Need bring-and-buy sale. Also, we mark 100 years since the end of WWI, reveal the 2019 Blue Peter Book Awards nominations and celebrate Mickey Mouse's 90th birthday.

eps.t: Bring and Buy for Children in Need
eps.d: It's the return of the Blue Peter Bring and Buy Sale, with a whole host of CBBC faces bringing and buying to raise money for Children in Need. There is the final part of Lindsey's Children in Need Swim Run Challenge and Radzi checks out one of the charitable causes that Children in Need supports.

We go behind the scenes at the creation of something special for Doctor Who herself. See how state of the art technology brings Danger Mouse's Penfold to life and head deep beneath the waves to find out how fish create light to survive in the dark. Also, we announce the winner of our latest competition.

It's a countdown to Blue Peter Christmas! We light the first candle on our Blue Peter Advent Crown, the stars of Nativity Rocks bring along some Christmas cheer to the studio and Lindsey and Radzi get their skates on in a speed-skating challenge.

eps.t: Awesome Competitions and a Cool Christmas Card
eps.d: The team demonstrate how to make a magical Blue Peter Christmas card that colours itself. They go behind the scenes at the New Hope Club music video shoot with our Lights, Camera, Action Competition winner, and launch a brand new competition with The Dumping Ground.
The cast of Wicked the musical join us in studio with a spectacular performance that you won't want to miss! Lindsey and Radzi go head to head in their frostiest challenge yet - go-karting on ice!

It's Christmas on Blue Peter! We celebrate with a 250-strong choir and a festive song from New Hope Club. Plus Lindsey and Radzi design their own Christmas jumpers, our traditional Advent Crown has a makeover and we announce the winner of our Christmas Cracker competition.
Lindsey and Radzi look back at Blue Peter's big 60th birthday year. With epic challenges, huge stars and incredible competitions - 2018 was the best year ever!

eps.d: Barney Harwood meets British astronaut Tim Peake to discuss his planned mission to the International Space Station and learns about his training techniques. Lindsey Russell helps to maintain the Channel Tunnel, and the green campaign continues live in the studio as a theatre company demonstrates how to turn rubbish into puppets.
Watch magicians Penn and Teller perform their amazing magic trick on Blue Peter, and then find out how they did it!

Barney and Radzi plan to take part in a hovercraft race. But will they have what it takes to get their licence before the big day? To make sure they are eating well, Jamie Oliver shows Barney how to make a healthy rainbow wrap.

eps.t: An Eco Edition of the Show
eps.d: An eco edition of the show, in which Lindsey Russell discovers the effect a few days' worth of rubbish has on the environment. Plus, she and Radzi Chinyanganya sample extreme carriage-racing, and scientist Greg Foot discusses the spacecraft Rosetta.

Radzi Chinyanganya, Lindsey Russell and Barney Harwood present a special edition from Baltic Square in Gateshead, Newcastle, where they celebrate three days of events and broadcasts from the North East by launching this year's Blue Peter Sport badge. They are joined on stage by British gymnastic champion Louis Smith and Paralympic gold medallist Hannah Cockroft.

The team broadcasts live from RSPB Minsmere in Suffolk, which is the home of this year's Springwatch series. Barney Harwood and Lindsey Russell celebrate the end of the Green Badge season with Chris Packham and Michaela Strachan. Plus, an eco-challenge reveals the effect a few days' waste can have on the environment.
The team broadcast live from the Blue Peter Garden where among other things there is a game of bubble football.

eps.t: Journey of a Guide Dog Puppy
eps.d: Presenter Lindsey Russell follows the journey of a guide dog puppy, and is in charge of picking its name. She also joins Barney Harwood to learn the lindy hop dance, and they attempt to pull off a show-stopping performance in front of an audience at the London Jitterbug Championships.

The team presents from Wimbledon, where Lindsey Russell offers an insight into the famous tennis tournament, and demonstrates how to make a fruit jelly. Radzi Chinyanganya meets young tennis player Jhonayah Fletchman, who is tipped to do well in the sport. Plus, a look behind the scenes at the West End musical Matilda.

eps.t: The Team Presents from Hebden Bridge
eps.d: The team presents from the Hebden Bridge Handmade Parade, and gets involved with the workshops and also demonstrates how to make an animal mask. Barney Harwood visits Silverstone race track to meet Scottish driver Susie Wolff.

Radzi Chinyanganya, Lindsey Russell and Barney Harwood team up with the stars of CBBC show Who Let the Dogs Out? to perform a special trick. Illustrator Quentin Blake answers viewers' questions and provides tips on drawing, and Inkquisitive artist Amandeep Singh demonstrates his talent.

Remember Blue Peter's competition to design sonic devices for Doctor Who's Paternoster Gang? In this Blue Peter special, Lindsey goes behind the scenes with the winners to see their Sonic Gauntlet, Lorgnette and Hat Pin in action - and they only run into Peter Capladi, the new Doctor, himself!

The presenters host a special edition live from Colwyn Bay, Conwy County Borough, and challenge one another to games on the sand. Barney Harwood learns about a surfing challenge and gets tips on how to be safe on a board. Plus, the winner of the badge poster competition is revealed.

The presenters are joined in the garden by boy band Union J, who will answer viewers' questions and perform their new single Tonight (We Live Forever), and Brit Award-winning artist Ed Sheeran shares his tips on songwriting. Plus, Barney Harwood takes a behind-the-scenes look at the new CBBC drama Harriet's Army.

The team presents from Switzerland as Lindsey Russell travels to Verbier to reveal her new challenge. Plus, a look back at some of the extreme tasks the presenters have taken on, including Barney Harwood coming face to face with the world's largest passenger airliner and Radzi Chinyanganya meeting a team of life-saving dogs.

eps.t: British Astronaut Tim Peake Mission Patch
eps.d: The team launches a competition to design a mission patch for British astronaut Tim Peake, which will be featured on his space suit as he sets out to become the first British person to visit the International Space Station. Radzi Chinyanganya gets to grips with racing Formula E cars and the new puppy Iggy is put to the test.

Barney Harwood goes behind the scenes of BBC drama Our Zoo to meet the cast, crew and animals. Radzi Chinyanganya and Lindsey Russell team up to race from Falmouth to Royal Greenwich in the Tall Ships Regatta. Plus, the stars of CBBC series Our School drop by to speak about having cameras in their classrooms, and there is an update on the Mission Patch

Barney Harwood attempts to surf the Severn Bore - one of the world's largest tidal surges, and the team look at the thousands of applications received for the 2014 Sport Badge. Plus, a special sporting star is given a gold Blue Peter badge.

The team present from both the BBC Philharmonic and the Blue Peter studio's to celebrate the BBC's Ten Pieces project, and Barney Harwood speaks to members of the station's orchestra. Radzi Chinyanganya attempts to play the alphorn in Switzerland, and the Shaolin Monks perform a mix of

Shelley the tortoise celebrates her 10th anniversary on the programme, and is visited by a vet as she prepares for hibernation. Radzi Chinyanganya and Lindsey Russell take on a mountain bike challenge along a Commonwealth Games track, and Barney Harwood learns how the Thames Barrier helps to protect London from tidal surges.

The team celebrates the Hindu festival of Diwali and there is a performance by singer-songwriter Arjun. Scientist Fran Scott conducts an experiment about germs, and Lindsey Russell discovers how ospreys build their nests. Plus, Radzi Chinyanganya begins a new challenge.

The team prepares for Halloween with a banquet, and is joined by a special effects make-up artist. Scientist Greg Foot explains what goes into a firework, and Radzi Chinyanganya is challenged to abseil down the Millennium Centre in Cardiff. Plus, Barney Harwood meets an artist who creates pieces using x-ray images.

Lindsay Russell embarks on a mammoth Mountain Marathon Challenge and Radzi Chinyanganya takes an exclusive look behind the scenes at Tower bridge. Plus, the presenters are joined in the studio by multi award-winning Japanese dance troupe Siro-A.

Michael Morpurgo, author of War Horse, joins the team as the Blue Peter Book Awards shortlist is revealed. Lindsey Russell faces another tough test while training for her Mountain Marathon challenge, and Barney Harwood goes behind the scenes of Get Santa! Plus, the presenters demonstrate how to make festive cards.

See Lindsey's entire Chair in the Air challenge from start to finish. Can Lindsey go from a complete beginner to a qualified hot air balloon pilot in just a few months? All to fly Blue Peter's Big Birthday Balloon solo!
Lindsey tries her hand at bell ringing. Radzi and a BP fan hit the red carpet for BBC Sports Personality of the Year 2018.
This week we're celebrating the purple badge! You, the viewers, are in control and the whole show will be dedicated to the things you love and want to see on the show.

This week on Blue Peter we celebrate the amazing letters sent in by you, and Radzi continues his stay aboard the gigantic aircraft carrier HMS Queen Elizabeth. Plus it's your last chance to apply for the limited edition Diamond badge!
Lindsey and Radzi celebrate lunar new year in style by making some dumplings! Plus Radzi joins indie band Blossoms to experience life on the road as they tour around the UK.
Radzi plays Cupid for Valentine’s Day and delivers your messages to loved ones.
We take a look at the amazing work that Comic Relief does and remind you of the nominees for the Blue Peter Book Awards 2019.
Featuring a brand new take on the classic story of The Wind in the Willows.
It’s the Blue Peter Book Awards 2019. A whole host of famous authors are live in studio to help reveal the winners of the Best Story and Best Book with Facts categories.

eps.t: Worst Witch Does Red Nose Day
eps.d: It’s a Red Nose Day special, so we team up with the cast of The Worst Witch to have you in stitches. Also, Danny and Mick cause chaos in the studio.
The Ehrlich Brothers perform incredible illusions in the studio. Lindsey gets up close with the ravens of the Tower of London and Radzi makes the final diamond badge delivery.
Blue Peter celebrates Mothering Sunday with Alesha Dixon and Angellica Bell. Find out how to make the perfect treat to spoil your loved ones.

eps.t: Amazing Animals and a Big Surprise!
eps.d: There’s a big announcement as we are joined in studio by a special new arrival. Pets Factor vet Rory pops in to talk animals and Gabrielle Aplin performs her latest single.
Lindsey and Radzi take on their last head-to-head challenge. Can they go back to basics and learn to survive in the wild? We head behind the scenes of new film Missing Link.
Radzi becomes a stunt performer in his final Blue Peter film.
We look back at the very best moments from Radzi’s five and a half years as a Blue Peter presenter.
We launch a new Blue Peter competition, giving you the chance to become a toy designer!
To kick off Blue Peter’s Green badge season eco-enthusiast Cel Spellman takes the reigns.
It’s the big day, as we meet the 38th Blue Peter presenter.
Lindsey and Richie take Henry the dog on a day trip to London to see some sights and continue his training.
Blue Peter has been given amazing access to Premier League champions Manchester City. Can Richie and ten-year-old City fan Braydon learn to manage their own team?
It’s an animal special as Lindsey meets the Kings Troop to get the horses ready for a big parade, and Clare Balding brings a four-legged friend into the garden.
Some green-fingered fans go gardening with HRH The Duchess of Cambridge
We take a look at this summer’s biggest blockbuster movies.
Lindsey takes on Richie in a crazy golf challenge.

Celebrating Notting Hill Carnival with Caribbean music, amazing costumes and tasty food.

Radio 1's Maya Jama is in charge as Guest Editor and we launch a brand new Blue Peter badge. Find out if Lindsey has got what it takes to conduct a world class orchestra, hear Paul McCartney's musical memories, and there's a festival in the studio with special musical guests.
After Richie and Henry get down and dirty in an outdoor obstacle course, Lindsey attempts to give our pooch a bath in studio!
On this week's Blue Peter we meet football superstar Raheem Sterling, Richie takes on a surfing challenge and there is a noisy make from author Liz Pichon for you to make-a-long at home too!
Lindsey and Richie launch the Big Blue Peter Bring and Buy Sale for Children in Need.

eps.d: Sir David Attenborough earns his Green Badge.
It's Halloween, so there's a spooky feel to Blue Peter! FOMO's Max and Harvey play a sneaky hidden camera trick, and there are treats as Lindsey shows how to make pumpkin pie.
Lindsey and Richie reveal the nominees for the Blue Peter Book Awards 2020.
A Children in Need special, including a giant bring-and-buy sale live in the studio.

eps.t: Blue Peter Fan Club Takeover: Gymnastics and Awesome Animals
eps.d: We've got gymnastics from the cast of new CBBC drama, My Perfect Landing; awesome animals as Henry takes on a challenge and a miniature Shetland pony joins us live in studio. Plus music from Blossoms.

eps.t: Harry Potter Cupcakes and Favourite Films
eps.d: We celebrate Harry Potter Book Night by showing you how to make sorting hat cupcakes. And Radio 1 film critic Ali Plumb joins us live in the studio ahead of the Oscars to award his favourite films.

eps.d: Daredevil presenter Steve Backshall is live in the studio.
Blue Peter is going green this week, as Richie helps some BP fans plant trees at the UK’s first young people’s forest and Lindsey makes bug bread.
